summary: 电解液溶剂不能合并成单一‘碳酸酯溶剂’成本：EC、DMC、EMC、DEC等品种的供需、原料路线和价格波动不同，配方mix变化会改变电解液成本传导。
why_search_may_miss_it: 公开电解液价格常以LiPF6为核心解释，溶剂篮子与配方mix变化容易被压缩成一个平均成本。

recalled_details.gap_reason: batch1 separated salt/solvent/additive/formulated electrolyte but did not preserve solvent-basket economics
recalled_details.schema_implication: electrolyte cost stack needs solvent_species and formulation_mix dimensions

suggested_queries: 电解液 EC DMC EMC DEC 溶剂 成本 价格
battery electrolyte carbonate solvent EC DMC EMC DEC cost
disconfirmation_queries: electrolyte solvent basket can be represented by one homogeneous carbonate price

summary: 电解液是高度客户定制的配方业务，配方共同开发、知识产权和长期验证会形成客户切换成本，因此名义通用产能不等于可立即替代的merchant供给。
why_search_may_miss_it: 价格与吨产能容易公开，但配方归属、共同开发和切换限制通常埋在招股书、客户结构或技术交流中。

recalled_details.gap_reason: batch1 covered formulation-dependent pricing but not formulation ownership and commercial stickiness
recalled_details.schema_implication: effective electrolyte capacity should carry customer_qualification/formulation_scope

suggested_queries: 电解液 定制 配方 客户 认证 联合开发
electrolyte customer specific formulation qualification switching
disconfirmation_queries: qualified electrolyte capacity is fully fungible across battery customers

summary: 钠离子电池商业化会形成与锂电不同的电解质盐、溶剂和添加剂需求，不能把钠电需求简单映射为LiPF6/传统锂电电解液增量。
why_search_may_miss_it: 钠电常被作为电芯技术单独讨论，传统电解液供需模型可能默认沿用锂电材料强度。

recalled_details.gap_reason: batch1 covered solid-state substitution but not sodium-ion electrolyte material substitution
recalled_details.schema_implication: electrolyte demand intensity must depend on battery_chemistry

suggested_queries: 钠离子 电解液 六氟磷酸钠 NaPF6 添加剂
sodium ion battery electrolyte NaPF6 formulation
disconfirmation_queries: sodium-ion battery electrolyte demand can be modeled as LiPF6 demand

summary: 高镍、高电压和快充体系往往提高对特定成膜、耐高压或含氟添加剂的要求，电解液中高价值添加剂的单位强度会随电芯路线变化而变化。
why_search_may_miss_it: VC/FEC等单品价格容易被追踪，但不同电芯路线下添加剂组合和添加量很少形成连续公开序列。

recalled_details.gap_reason: batch1 captured VC/FEC bottleneck but not chemistry-dependent additive intensity

suggested_queries: 高镍 高电压 快充 电解液 添加剂 配方
high nickel high voltage fast charge electrolyte additive loading
disconfirmation_queries: electrolyte additive intensity is constant across battery chemistries

summary: 成品电解液对水分、HF等杂质控制、洁净灌装、储运和保质期要求严格，混配罐名义吨数之外的质量控制与物流条件会限制真正可交付产能。
why_search_may_miss_it: 产能公告关注混配规模，质量控制和成品物流限制通常只出现在规格、客户认证或工艺资料。

recalled_details.gap_reason: batch1 covered LiPF6 process purity but not formulated-electrolyte delivery quality constraints
recalled_details.schema_implication: effective capacity should include qualified_packaging_storage_delivery state

suggested_queries: 电解液 水分 HF 保质期 灌装 储运 客户认证
battery electrolyte moisture HF shelf life filling logistics
disconfirmation_queries: electrolyte blending nameplate capacity equals immediately deliverable qualified capacity
disconfirmation_source_types: 实际合格出货/退货数据

summary: 单位GWh电解液耗用量不是固定常数，会随能量密度、电芯尺寸、液注比、化成损耗和lean-electrolyte设计变化，跨年代需求换算必须保存材料强度vintage。
why_search_may_miss_it: 行业需求预测常使用固定吨/GWh假设，技术进步导致的单位耗用变化不一定被历史数据库保留。
